name: 左文右圖＋底部超大跑馬燈文字
desc: 左欄大標題與文字連結，右欄橫式圖片貼齊畫面右緣；背景下段換色，底部一行超大文字持續水平流動，壓在圖片後方。
prompt: 區塊上下不留白。版面分左右兩欄：左欄約佔畫面寬的四成多，放大標題（可多行），標題下方可放一個文字連結（短文字加右側一個小圓形箭頭圖示），沒有內容時省略，標題位置不變；左欄靠左對齊頁面內容寬度，在主視覺上段的空白區內垂直置中。右欄放一張橫式圖片，約佔畫面寬的一半多，貼齊主視覺上緣與畫面右緣，下緣不到主視覺底緣。主視覺背景分成上下兩段：上段約佔三分之二，下段換成另一種底色，一直延伸到主視覺底緣。下段底部放一行超大文字，左右都超出畫面、被畫面邊緣裁切；文字下半部被主視覺底緣裁切，字底貼齊主視覺底緣，下方沒有空白；這行文字持續往同一方向水平流動（跑馬燈）；圖片在這行文字前面，蓋住它的右側部分。
mobile: 左右兩欄改為上下排列：大標題與文字連結在上並靠左對齊，圖片在下；圖片改為接近方形，左側留邊、對齊頁面內容寬度的左緣，右側貼齊畫面右緣。背景下段的另一種底色改從圖片中段開始；超大文字仍在下段底部、在圖片後方，下半部同樣被主視覺底緣裁切，字底貼齊底緣、下方沒有空白，跑馬燈保留。主視覺底邊約在畫面九成高的位置。

en.name: Split text left, image right, giant marquee band
en.desc: A headline and text link on the left, a landscape image flush with the right edge on the right; the lower part of the background changes color and a giant line of text scrolls horizontally behind the image.
en.prompt: The section has no spacing at the top or bottom. The layout is split into two columns: the left column takes a little over forty percent of the viewport width and holds a headline (may wrap to multiple lines); optionally place a text link below the headline (short text with a small circular arrow icon to its right); omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline. The left column is left-aligned to the page content width and vertically centered within the empty upper part of the hero. The right column holds a landscape image taking a little over half the viewport width, flush with the top edge of the hero and the right edge of the viewport; its bottom edge stops short of the bottom of the hero. The hero background is split into two bands: the upper band takes about two thirds, and the lower band switches to a different background color that extends to the bottom edge of the hero. At the bottom of the lower band, place a single line of giant text that extends past both sides of the viewport and is cropped by the viewport edges; the lower half of the text is cropped by the bottom edge of the hero, so the text is flush with the bottom edge of the hero with no space below it; the line flows continuously in one direction (marquee); the image is in front of this text and covers its right part.
en.mobile: The two columns stack vertically: the headline and text link on top, left-aligned, with the image below; the image becomes roughly square, with a margin on the left aligned to the left edge of the page content width and flush with the right edge of the viewport on the right. The lower band of different background color now starts at the middle of the image; the giant text stays at the bottom of the lower band, behind the image, with its lower half likewise cropped by the bottom edge of the hero, flush with that edge and no space below it, and the marquee is kept. The bottom edge of the hero sits at about ninety percent of the viewport height.
